title: Comparative Analysis of 3D Convolutional and 2.5D Slice-Conditioned U-Net Architectures for MRI Super-Resolution via Elucidated Diffusion Models
abstract: arXiv:2603.14667v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) super-resolution (SR) methods that computationally enhance low-resolution acquisitions offer a software alternative to higher-field scanners. We study an elucidated diffusion model (EDM) framework for 2x in-plane brain MRI SR and compare two U-Net backbones: (i) a 3D convolutional U-Net that processes volumetric patches and (ii) a 2.5D slice-conditioned U-Net that super-resolves each slice while conditioning on its two neighbouring slices. All models are trained from scratch to convergence on 500 subjects of the NKI cohort of FOMO60K, with a separate 6-subject validation set for checkpoint selection, and evaluated on 70 held-out subjects with subject-level statistics against baselines (EDSR, Swin2SR, Res-SRDiff) trained on the same data. Neither architecture is better overall. On the degradation used in training the two are tied (37.72 dB PSNR for the 3D model and 37.70 dB for the 2.5D model), 0

translated_title: 基于阐明扩散模型的3D卷积与2.5D切片条件U-Net架构在MRI超分辨率中的比较分析
translated_abstract: 磁共振成像（MRI）超分辨率（SR）方法通过计算方式增强低分辨率采集图像，为更高场强扫描仪提供了一种软件层面的替代方案。我们研究了一种用于2倍面内脑部MRI超分辨率的阐明扩散模型（EDM）框架，并比较了两种U-Net骨干网络：（i）处理体积块的3D卷积U-Net，以及（ii）2.5D切片条件U-Net，该网络在对相邻两个切片进行条件约束的同时对每个切片进行超分辨率处理。所有模型均在FOMO60K数据集NKI队列的500名受试者上从头训练至收敛，使用单独的6名受试者验证集进行检查点选择，并在70名保留受试者上以受试者级别的统计指标与在相同数据上训练的基线模型（EDSR、Swin2SR、Res-SRDiff）进行比较。两种架构总体上没有明显的优劣之分。在训练所用的退化条件下，两者表现持平（3D模型为37.72 dB PSNR，2.5D模型为37.70 dB PSNR），……
tldr: 该研究在阐明扩散模型框架下系统比较了3D卷积U-Net与2.5D切片条件U-Net两种骨干架构用于脑部MRI的2倍面内超分辨率重建，发现两者总体性能相当，在训练退化条件下PSNR分别为37.72 dB和37.70 dB。
en_tdlr: This study systematically compares 3D convolutional and 2.5D slice-conditioned U-Net backbones within an elucidated diffusion model framework for 2x in-plane brain MRI super-resolution, finding neither architecture is overall superior, with the two tied at 37.72 dB and 37.70 dB PSNR under the training degradation.
